headline: Clean Harbors posts record profits as margins expand
summary_short: Clean Harbors' Q2 2026 revenue rose 11.9% y/y to $1,735.0M, with net income up 34.3% y/y to $170.5M ($3.22 diluted EPS) as SKSS segment Adjusted EBITDA margin nearly doubled to 33.4% from 19.4% and Environmental Services margin also expanded.
summary_long: Q2 2026 revenue rose 11.9% y/y to $1,735.0M, led by Environmental Services (+7.7%) on Technical Services growth including a $30M+ PFAS filtration project, and SKSS (+40.8%) on higher oil-product pricing. Adjusted EBITDA rose 21.6% y/y to $409.0M as margin expanded 190bp to 23.6%, with SKSS margin nearly doubling to 33.4%. Net income rose 34.3% y/y to $170.5M ($3.22 diluted EPS). Clean Harbors raised FY2026 net capex guidance to $490-550M for added growth investments. Cash fell to $408.4M after $357.6M spent on the Depot Connect International and Terra Nova acquisitions; it repurchased $25.0M of stock in the quarter with $549.4M remaining under its buyback authorization.
